title: EMONET-VOICE: A LARGE-SCALE SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK FOR FINE-GRAINED SPEECH EMOTION

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing speech emotion recognition (SER) model accuracy and correlation scores across a 40-category emotion taxonomy, specifically contrasting the high recognition rates of high-arousal, acoustically salient emotions (e.g., anger, teasing) against the poor performance on low-arousal, subtle internal states (e.g., concentration, emotional numbness).

Measuring and comparing the refusal rates (NaN outputs) of commercial models (such as GPT-4o Audio and Hume Voice) when evaluating audio samples that portray sensitive or restricted emotional content, such as sexual lust and intoxication.
